title: Catford Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency health facilities, flood zones, and essential supply points for Catford.
content: For life-threatening emergencies, call 999 immediately. 1. Nearest Hospitals with 24-Hour A&E: - University Hospital Lewisham (Lewisham High Street, London SE13 6LH). Directions from Catford Bridge Station: ~15 min walk north along the A21 Lewisham High Street (0.7 miles), or take bus 47, 54, 136, 199, or 208 north. - King's College Hospital (Denmark Hill, London SE5 9RS) — Designated Major Trauma Centre. Directions from Catford Station: ~4 miles north-west; take Thameslink train direct to Denmark Hill, or take bus 185 west towards Camberwell. 2. NHS Urgent Treatment Centres: - Lewisham Urgent Treatment Centre (University Hospital Lewisham, Lewisham High Street, SE13 6LH). Provides urgent care for non-life-threatening ailments, sprains, wounds, and minor burns. Located just 0.7 miles north of Catford Broadway via the A21. - Beckenham Beacon Urgent Treatment Centre (379 Croydon Road, Beckenham, BR3 3QL). Directions from Bellingham Station: ~35 min walk south-west via Southend Lane and Beckenham Hill Road (1.7 miles), or bus 54 south towards Elmers End. 3. Local Hazard Notes: The River Pool and River Ravensbourne converge near Catford Bridge and Ladywell Fields. Low-lying terrain along Adenmore Road, Waterlink Way, and around Bellingham playing fields is prone to rapid fluvial flooding after intense rainfall. 4. Essential Supplies: Supermarkets and pharmacies situated along Rushey Green (A21), Catford Broadway, and Bromley Road stock bottled water, infant supplies, and first-aid kits. Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
